db.name: DevBoard
db.footer: signed notes on nostr relays · proof of work keeps the spam out · notes expire
db.empty: Nothing here yet. Be the first to pin a note.
db.contactNote: The poster wrote this themselves. Check who you are talking to before sharing anything sensitive or sending money.
db.ownVote: You can’t vote on your own note
db.voteLimit: Slow down: ten votes per half minute.
db.blocked: Blocked. Their notes and votes are hidden on all your devices.
db.reportText: Reports go to the relays, signed by you, so relay operators and other clients can act. Notes reported by several people are collapsed here.
db.collapsedCap: Hidden: this person already has three live notes.
db.compose.title: Pin a note
db.compose.titlePlaceholder: e.g. React dev wanted for a shop relaunch
db.compose.text: What you need or what you offer
db.compose.textPlaceholder: Short and concrete. Stack, scope, timeline…
db.compose.contactHint: Shown only when someone taps Contact. Everything else is public on the relays until the note expires.
db.compose.published: Pinned. It shows up for others as the relays pass it on.
db.compose.needRelay: No relay connected: a note has to reach a relay to be seen.
db.compose.textRequired: Say what you need or offer.
db.compose.contactRequired: Add a way to reach you.
db.limit: Three live notes per person. Delete one to pin another.
db.how.1: A note is a signed nostr event on the relays you use. Everyone sees the same board; nobody can edit or remove your note but you.
db.how.3: Three live notes per person, and notes expire. Relays drop them when they do.
db.how.4: Votes are signed too, one per person and note. Notes voted down far enough collapse; so do notes several people reported.
db.settings.defaultsText: Filled in when you pin a note; everything stays editable there. Saved in your account.
